x-contract.authority: the adapter may only translate a legacy snapshot request; plan/today/SRS facts remain learning-service-owned
x-contract.legacyRequestFieldPolicy: every declared legacy field is explicitly translated, validated against a server-derived fact, or rejected; unknown fields are denied

timezone.clientAuthority: assertion only; never used to derive dueAt or plan facts

dailyNewTarget.serverDerivedFact: today plan count of eligible NEW_CORE tasks

maxDailyReview.serverDerivedFact: today plan count of eligible SRS/repair review tasks

scheduleType.serverDerivedFact: P1_DAILY_PLAN_V1 schedule and active plan status

x-migration.responseTranslation: translate only server-owned B10TodayLearningPlan facts into the legacy snapshot envelope; if any requested legacy field has no equivalent server fact, reject or quarantine instead of silently dropping it

x-authorization.clientAuthority: none for plan, SRS state or schedule

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: 相同请求返回首次快照

x-contract.authority: one canonical review command owns SRS scheduling, repair workflow and mastery projection

x-authorization.clientAuthority: observed review only; result, effective quality, interval, dueAt, algorithm, mastery and tenant are forbidden

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: 重复复习事件只结算一次

x-contract.batchAdapter: translate each legacy event into one canonical review command; never calculate or batch-write SRS state

x-authorization.clientAuthority: observed review only; each event is subject to canonical idempotency and version conflict

x-contract.authority: SRS state is a learning-service read projection; D1/D7 verification remains a separate repair field

x-authorization.clientAuthority: none; summary is translated from server-owned learning projection
